answer: vertex is the single register binding key, route and first verdict; each falcon is one clone forced onto that file. To stay live, a file burns voyage, fresh judged-work hours that decay, at rate (live files)^2 per epoch and nontransferable. Holding n falcon costs n^3 voyage every epoch; idling one forfeits its place. It fails if vertex merges aliases, work mint replays, or voyage moves.
